title: ECC Hooks Metadata
description: Stable ids and human-readable descriptions for the matcher entries in hooks/hooks.json. Kept in a sidecar because Claude Code reports any key outside its own hooks schema as an unknown key when the plugin loads.

entries.description: Event name to an array aligned by index with the same event's entries in hooks.json.

id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for the matcher entry at this index.

fingerprint.description: First 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the matcher entry (matcher + hooks, keys sorted) at this index in hooks.json. Binds the sidecar entry to a specific matcher so a reorder is detected. Regenerate with `node scripts/ci/validate-hooks.js --update-fingerprints`.
